notes: Four routes, each opened by «حدثنا / وحدثني»; all carry the same description of the Prophet's appearance (the hilya), so they are routes to one saying, not variants.
Route 1 writes «قال: حدثني رجل بمكة»: the unnamed man is a gap (rule 8). Ibn Abi Hala is named as Ibn Abi Hala, not merged with the uncle Hind (rule 9).
Route 2 and route 3 are read from «قال الحسن بن علي» and «عن الحسن بن علي»; the Imam Hasan is the last link in each.

The remark «إلى ها هنا رواه أبو القاسم ... والباقي رواية عبد الرحمن» and Hussain's own question («قال الحسين عليه السلام: سألت أبي») are not written as routes here: the second is a further saying whose transmission is not fully written, so it is left out rather than guessed.
